texts.name: Design the complete Fruit Hub mobile app: Tony tells the app their first name, browses fruit salad combos, adds one to the basket, checks out with delivery details or a card, and tracks the delivery. Canvas 375 × 812, iPhone, light mode. Work in your own new Figma file — this file is read-only reference.

Design the complete Fruit Hub mobile app: Tony tells the app their first name, browses fruit salad combos, adds one to the basket, checks out with delivery details or a card, and tracks the delivery.
Canvas 375 × 812, iPhone, light mode. Work in your own new Figma file — this file is read-only reference.

texts.name: 1. Build exactly the 10 frames below, named exactly as listed (one state per frame), and wire them as a clickable prototype with the listed links. 2. Everything in “Must include” must appear on that frame. The lists are grouped by subject and sorted alphabetically — they are not in screen order and say nothing about layout, grouping, emphasis or styling. Those are your decisions. 3. The brand primary color and the typeface in 01 · Foundations are fixed. Define every other color yourself (neutrals, text, surfaces, success / error / warning / disabled, supporting colors), plus type scale, spacing, radii and elevation, and apply them consistently. 4. 02 · Components gives only a default Button, a default Text Field and the platform shell (status bar, home indicator). Design all other states, the headers, the sheets and every business component as reusable components in your file. 5. Use the logo, product photos, illustrations, map and icons from 04 · Media. Prices use the Naira glyph (Icon_Naira or “₦”). 6. Copy and data must match “Fixed data” exactly. This brief wins over anything you may know of the original kit.
texts.text:
1. Build exactly the 10 frames below, named exactly as listed (one state per frame), and wire them as a clickable prototype with the listed links.
2. Everything in “Must include” must appear on that frame. The lists are grouped by subject and sorted alphabetically — they are not in screen order and say nothing about layout, grouping, emphasis or styling. Those are your decisions.
3. The brand primary color and the typeface in 01 · Foundations are fixed. Define every other color yourself (neutrals, text, surfaces, success / error / warning / disabled, supporting colors), plus type scale, spacing, radii and elevation, and apply them consistently.
4. 02 · Components gives only a default Button, a default Text Field and the platform shell (status bar, home indicator). Design all other states, the headers, the sheets and every business component as reusable components in your file.
5. Use the logo, product photos, illustrations, map and icons from 04 · Media. Prices use the Naira glyph (Icon_Naira or “₦”).
6. Copy and data must match “Fixed data” exactly. This brief wins over anything you may know of the original kit.
